column4: a big bright red city bus parked at a bus stop on a sunny street, doors open. No people.
a small white-and-grey cartoon cat climbs the steps onto a big bright red city bus.
a small brown puppy with floppy ears climbs onto a big bright red city bus; a small white-and-grey cartoon cat is already sitting by the window inside.
a round pink piglet climbs onto a big bright red city bus; a small brown puppy with floppy ears and a small white-and-grey cartoon cat are already sitting by the windows inside.

a big bright red city bus drives fast along the road, little puffs of exhaust and motion lines, a small white-and-grey cartoon cat, a small brown puppy with floppy ears and a round pink piglet looking out of the windows happily.
a small white-and-grey cartoon cat, a small brown puppy with floppy ears and a round pink piglet cheer and jump for joy in a sunny green park with big trees, the red bus parked behind them.
a fluffy little yellow duckling standing at the edge of a pond, smiling.
a fluffy little yellow duckling swimming and splashing happily in the pond, little water drops flying.
a fluffy little yellow duckling flapping its tiny wings hard but its feet stay on the ground; it cannot fly yet. A few clouds in the sky.
its mother, a white duck with an orange beak flying up into the sky over the pond; a fluffy little yellow duckling watches from the water below.
a fluffy little yellow duckling eating bread crumbs by the pond and growing a little bigger.
The duckling, now bigger with white feathers, flies happily up into the blue sky next to the sun.
Max, a cheeky little brown monkey with a cream face and a long curly tail sitting on a tree branch in a sunny jungle, waving.
Max, a cheeky little brown monkey with a cream face and a long curly tail holding his tummy, looking hungry, licking his lips.
Max, a cheeky little brown monkey with a cream face and a long curly tail eating a red apple happily.
Max, a cheeky little brown monkey with a cream face and a long curly tail peeling and eating a yellow banana happily.
Max, a cheeky little brown monkey with a cream face and a long curly tail eating a slice of strawberry cake with a big grin, crumbs on his face.
Max, a cheeky little brown monkey with a cream face and a long curly tail lying on a branch with a round full tummy, yawning and sleepy.
Pip the little fox walks happily to a red farm with a barn and a green tractor.
A black-and-white cow in a field saying moo, mouth open; Pip listens nearby.
A pink pig in a muddy pen saying oink; Pip watches and smiles.
A white duck by the farm pond saying quack; Pip watches.
A brown hen sitting proudly next to exactly three white eggs in a straw nest; Pip counts them, delighted.
Pip waves goodbye to the farm animals (cow, pig, duck, hen) at the farm gate at sunset.
It is cold and snowing; Ella and Leo in warm coats, scarves and hats look up at the falling snowflakes in a snowy garden.
Ella and Leo roll big snowballs and build a big snowman in the snowy garden.
Ella puts a carrot nose on the snowman while Leo watches; the snowman has coal eyes and a smile.
Leo puts a black top hat on the snowman; the snowman now has a carrot nose and a black hat.
The sun comes out bright and warm over the garden; the snowman with the carrot nose and black hat starts to drip.
The snowman has melted into a tiny little snowman in a puddle, with the carrot nose and black hat lying beside it; Ella and Leo look surprised.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes sitting on a doorstep, looking cute.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes trots out into a sunny garden to play.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes chases a falling autumn leaf deep into tall grass and bushes, then looks around, lost and worried.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes looks up at a friendly brown dog and asks if it is his mom; the dog shakes its head.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes looks up at a little bird on a fence; the bird shakes its head.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes looks up at a big black-and-white cow in a field; the cow shakes its head.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes sees Tom's mother, a big grey tabby cat with white paws coming toward him and runs to her joyfully.
Tom, a tiny fluffy grey tabby kitten with white paws and big eyes cuddled up happily with Tom's mother, a big grey tabby cat with white paws, little hearts around them.
Pip the little fox holds a few seeds in his paw in a garden, looking at them curiously.
Pip kneels and puts the seeds into small holes in the soil.
Gentle rain falls on the garden soil where the seeds are planted; Pip watches from under a leaf umbrella.
The hot sun shines brightly on the garden soil; Pip wipes his forehead.
A tiny green sprout pokes out of the soil; Pip looks at it with wonder.
The plant has grown taller with many leaves, taller than Pip.
A giant sunflower, the biggest flower of all, towering over the other flowers in the garden.
Pip hugs the stem of the giant sunflower, very happy.
A turtle and a brown rabbit stand side by side at a start line in a meadow, ready for a race.
The brown rabbit runs very fast along the path, ears back, dust flying.
The turtle walks slowly along the path, step by step.
The brown rabbit lies down and sleeps under a shady tree beside the path.
The turtle keeps walking and walking past the sleeping rabbit.
The turtle crosses the finish line ribbon, smiling proudly.
The brown rabbit wakes up under the tree and sees the race is over, shocked.
The turtle holds up a small gold trophy, proud and happy, flowers around.
A sunny day in the park; Pip the little fox carries a red ball.
Pip kicks the red ball very high; it flies over the tops of the trees.
The sky over the park gets dark with big grey clouds; Pip looks up, worried.
A big thunderstorm: lightning flashes and heavy rain; Pip covers his ears, scared.
Pip runs as fast as he can through the rain toward his little house.
At home, Pip's mom, a grown-up fox in a lavender cardigan wraps Pip in a warm towel and gives him a cup of hot milk.
After the rain, Pip stands outside and sees a big rainbow in the sky.
Pip finds his red ball under a tree, holding it up happily.

Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt wearing a new pink school backpack, standing at her front door on her first school morning.
Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt looking a little scared and shy, clutching her backpack straps.

A big bright kindergarten classroom full of children playing; Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt stands at the door.

a kind young Taiwanese woman teacher with glasses and a blue blouse smiles and points to a small chair at a table, inviting Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt to sit.

Sam, a 5-year-old Taiwanese boy with short brown hair, a green hoodie and shorts sits next to Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt at the table and hands her a red crayon.

Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt and Sam, a 5-year-old Taiwanese boy with short brown hair, a green hoodie and shorts draw a big sun and a little house together on a big sheet of paper.

Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt and Sam, a 5-year-old Taiwanese boy with short brown hair, a green hoodie and shorts smile and hold hands as new friends in the classroom.
At home, Lily, a 5-year-old Taiwanese girl with long black hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow ribbon, a purple T-shirt and a denim skirt hugs her mother happily, still wearing her backpack.
